blocks.text: BAGUIO CITY — Rescuers on Monday retrieved the body of a 20-year-old man who was earlier swept away by strong currents while crossing the Chico River in Lubuagan, Kalinga. The body of Jasper Cawi Pallogan was recovered at around 4 p.m. in the river in Barangay Bantay, Tabuk City. Pallogan was carried away by currents at around 6:30 a.m. while attempting to cross the river near the fishing community of Begwang in Barangay Tanglag.
